title: Outbreak
html:
Quest Giver: Junior Exec Ivan

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Kill 24 Poison Mutant Pincers in Upper Frump's Misfortune - Levels 3 & 4 and Return to Junior Exec Ivan in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Junior Exec Ivan

Repeatable: No

Zone: Frump's Misfortune (quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Kill 24 Poison Mutant Pincers in Upper Frump's Misfortune - Levels 3 & 4 and Return to Junior Exec Ivan in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort.

Offer:

While you were out culling the outbreak earlier, Frump Labs found out what has been causing the rise of infected Dungeon Runners. The Poison Mutant Pincers are carrying a highly contagious strain of what the alchemists have dubbed Ick. The Pincers carry Ick, but when they come into contact with the other Poison Mutants it, well, it mutates. The alchemists call the mutated Poison Mutant strain Ick-E. Yeah, it sounds bad and no amount of circle, circle, dot, dot will keep it contained.

To keep the strain from spreading further The Frump wants you to get in there and destroy the Poison Mutant Pincers before the outbreak gets worse. The competition to become The Flunky is really heating up and other Dungeon Runners are out there competing for the same opportunity. Time for you to make YOUR mark!

The main areas of Upper Frump's Misfortune - Levels 3 & 4 are where you will find this Poison Mutant Pincers. Get in there, take out those Pincers, and return to me, Junior Exec Ivan, in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort.

Turn-in:

Initial reports are showing that you have really cutback the amount of Ick in Frump's Misfortune. Thanks for getting in there and fighting this Ick-E strain.

Objectives:

  • Slain Poison Mutant Pincers

Level range: 28–45
